reasoning_quality_informational.v1_root_problem: Dispute tickets roughly doubled from ~600/month (Jun-Jul) to ~1180-1260/month (Aug-Sep 2026) (E-05), primarily because a majority (59%, 1785/3025) of disputed bills carry ACTUAL, not ESTIMATED, meter reads (E-02) — pointing to a defect in the billing import/validation step that miscalculates bills on normally-read accounts, not to a tariff change (ruled out, E-04) and not to slow ticket response (ruled out, E-03). Estimate-substitution problems (field route shortfall, E-01) can at most explain the minority ESTIMATED share of disputes, not the surge's majority driver.
